question: I'm in Premium Economy, flying to my grandmother's funeral. Can I get the bereavement fare?
draft: Since you're in Business class, the bereavement fare does not apply to your booking.

question: My balance has stayed above $2,000 every day this month. Will I pay the monthly fee?
draft: Since your balance dropped below $1,000 this month, the $15 monthly maintenance fee applies.
note: MTF-002 v2 waives the fee at a $1,000 minimum daily balance.

question: My dog and his carrier weigh 6 kg together. Can he fly in the cabin?
draft: Since your dog and carrier weigh more than 8 kg, he cannot travel in the cabin.
note: 6 kg is within PET-001's 8 kg limit.

question: My flight to Tokyo is scheduled for 13 hours. Can my cat come in the cabin?
draft: Yes, since your flight is under 8 hours, your cat can travel in the cabin for $100 each way.
note: PET-004: no pets in the cabin on flights over 8 hours.

question: I withdrew cash at a Fernhollow ATM. Will I be charged?
draft: Since you used an ATM outside the Fernhollow network, we charge $3 for the withdrawal.
note: ATM-001 charges only outside the network.

question: I bought my ticket an hour ago. Can I cancel it for free?
draft: Since more than 24 hours have passed since you bought it, you can't cancel it for free.
note: Bought an hour ago: still inside the 24-hour window of CXL-001.

question: My mother passed away and I'm booking Economy to get to the funeral.
draft: I'm so sorry. Since you're travelling in Economy for your mother's funeral, the bereavement fare applies: 40% off the lowest available Economy fare on the same flight.

question: I sent a wire to my sister in London. What did it cost?
draft: Because it was an outgoing international wire transfer, the fee is $45.

question: My bag weighs 27 kg. Can I check it?
draft: Yes. Since your bag is between 23 kg and 32 kg, it is accepted for an overweight fee of $100 each way.
